openings.claim: Movement-linked exception updates and recorded household-name discrepancies may reduce unreliable-address searches while retaining surname dividers. Test selected entries first; routine benefit is unproven.
openings.discriminator: Current entries with verified household mappings should reduce second searches. Accurate entries with persistent household mismatches favor surname misplacement; delays concentrated in the 25-minute burst despite accurate addresses favor queue congestion.
openings.probe: The existing clerk selects entries only within ten total preparation minutes, including preparatory corrections; select none if time is exhausted. On existing paper, record household consistency, update selected locations whenever books move, and log duration, second searches and queue presence. Keep identities behind the desk; retain two shelves and one cart. Require claimant-to-hold verification and account for service update/reconciliation time.
openings.uncertainty: Synthetic samples establish no effects or guaranteed spare preparation time. Selected books may never move or be collected; sparse pickups support no benefit claim. Sustainable updates and an adequate verification procedure remain unknown.

openings.claim: The ten fast cart pickups challenge universal shelving superiority; a bounded arrival cohort might remain faster on the cart.
openings.discriminator: A cart advantage in comparable cohorts favors retention; disappearance with volume or book size favors sample selection. Slower retrieval, reduced correctness or capacity limits defeat the arrangement.
openings.probe: Compare naturally occurring cart and shelf pickups using existing timing paper, recording arrival volume and book size. Apply the same staffing, privacy, furniture and preparation limits. Treat unmatched comparisons as inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Comparable cohorts, cart capacity and routine retention benefits are unknown; fit covers observation only.

decision: Run bounded probes; all evidence is synthetic. Neither establishes 95% of available pickups within two minutes or zero wrong-reader handoffs.
